references.text: God's love for Abraham and the promise to bless his descendants, which is the basis for God's election of Israel
The Lord brought the people out of Egypt with a strong hand, confirming God's mighty deliverance
Describes how the Lord led Israel out of Egypt with a strong hand
Explains that the Lord loved Israel and chose them because of the oath He swore to their fathers
The Lord took delight in their fathers and loved them, and He chose their descendants
Israel is called Abraham's offspring, my friend, showing God's love for the fathers
In His love and compassion He redeemed them and carried them all the former days
Paul quotes that God loved Jacob, confirming God's election based on love
For the sake of their fathers the Israelites are loved by God, consistent with God's love for the ancestors
